event_summary: A lit stick moves from the right toward a black balloon, contacts its lower-right side, and the balloon abruptly disappears as dark fragments fly away.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a glossy black balloon on the left side of a wooden tabletop and a black circular base on the right. A pale stick is attached near the top of the base and extends outward with a small orange flame at its free end. The flaming end moves in an arc from the lower right toward the balloon. The flame reaches the lower-right edge of the balloon, after which the balloon rapidly changes from an intact sphere to absent from its prior location, while small dark pieces blur upward and leftward. The stick remains extended from the base, and the tabletop area where the balloon had been is empty afterward.

reasons: The intact black balloon, tabletop, circular base, stick, and flame area are visible at the start.
The flame is partly near the lower-right edge of the frame but still visible.
